diagram_math_checks.objects: A={w:r<|w|<R}, C_r={|w|=r}, C_R={|w|=R}, z in A
diagram_math_checks.check: The local def-complex-annulus and Example specify concentric circles centred at zero with 0<r<R; the even-odd fill excludes the hole. In drawing coordinates the circles have radii 0.8 and 1.8 and z=(1.1,0.6) has modulus sqrt(1.57), strictly between them. The dashed radial guide is not a map or a probabilistic path.

Because log is strictly increasing and r<|z|<R, log r<t<log R; the separate schematic axis marks this order and the positive interval lengths t-log r and log R-t. The axis uses logarithmic coordinates and makes no Euclidean-distance assertion.

diagram_math_checks.objects: s on closure A and the two masses
diagram_math_checks.check: Step 1.4 defines s(w)=(log R-log|w|)/log(R/r), continuous on closure A and harmonic on A, with s=1 on C_r and s=0 on C_R. Steps 2.2 and 3.1 identify omega_A^z(C_r)=s(z) and omega_A^z(C_R)=1-s(z). The diagram uses the right-hand interval for C_r and the left-hand interval for C_R, each divided by the total logarithmic interval. Their sum is one and both are positive by step 4.1.
The figure is outside the Facts and Verification sections. All original proof text and hypotheses remain unchanged; the rigorous proof remains independent of the illustration.
